fairing.name: Payload fairing
fairing.description: Protects the payload from airflow, then jettisons above about 100 km.
fairing.source: Inspired by real Thor-Delta and Atlas-Agena payload fairings, 1960s.

interstage.name: Interstage
interstage.description: Connects two stages and carries separation hardware.
interstage.source: Inspired by real Thor-Able and Atlas-Centaur interstage adapters, 1950-60s.

escape_tower.name: Launch escape tower
escape_tower.description: Adds mass but can pull the capsule clear if the booster fails during launch.
escape_tower.source: Inspired by the real Mercury and Apollo launch escape systems, 1960s.

heat_shields.name: Thin heat shield
heat_shields.description: Enough for a low Earth orbit return, no more.
heat_shields.source: Inspired by the real ablative heat shield on Mercury capsules, 1961.

heat_shields.name: Standard heat shield
heat_shields.description: Comfortable margin for orbital returns and mild high-energy returns.
heat_shields.source: Inspired by the real Gemini ablative heat shield, 1965.

heat_shields.name: Heavy heat shield
heat_shields.description: Needed for lunar-return speeds. Heavy, but it keeps the crew alive.
heat_shields.source: Inspired by the real Apollo command module Avcoat ablative heat shield, 1966-68.
